comment: The recorder writes each moves character as UTF-8 at an input boundary and keeps moves.length + 1 boundaries, but tty_nhgetch() reads one byte per boundary and the game does not wait for the recorder. 'ñ' (C3 B1) and 'ü' (C3 BC) each open #conduct (M-C), whose window ignores the second byte until Escape closes it, so the game is two bytes behind the recorder at its last kept boundary. It reads the final two 's' afterwards and searches twice, and the recorder's last read of the line-buffered RNG log holds those turns' calls.
